data.one_liner: CLI to manage Flutter SDK versions per project
data.what_it_does: FVM lets you install, switch, and cache multiple Flutter SDKs, keeping project SDKs consistent and speeding up channel changes.
use_when: You need multiple Flutter SDKs for different projects
You want fast SDK switching without reinstalling
You want to pin a specific SDK version per project
avoid_when: You only use a single Flutter SDK
You prefer a GUI tool over CLI
data.setup_notes: Add to pubspec and run `fvm install`
